description: teamrig: load the team rules at session start, ask before a push to a protected branch and refuse a force-push or delete of one, hold once a message that would wake an idle session cold, hold every message to the lead but a CRITICAL one while the owner's daily meeting is open, answer a send that was not delivered with the inbox line to write instead, ask before or refuse a helper launch past the daily budget or in quiet hours as the team set, remind a session of unread inbox lines, ask a session once per turn to batch when it runs single-step calls in a row, record a Claude Code rename of the session as its team name, ask for a handover at a task boundary when a context refresh is due, wake a session /clear started from its refresh so it carries on, and warn a session past its daily budget. Its mod (register.ts) adds /teamrig <command>, which runs a teamrig command in the tab and shows its output with no model turn (a read at once, a write only when typed by the person), runs that /clear in the tab when the automatic restart asks, once the session is quiet, and runs /reload-plugins in the tab once an installed plugin changed, while no turn runs.
